children: MSC Income Fund entered into a Master Note Purchase Agreement with qualified institutional investors to issue $150 million of 6.83% Series A Senior Notes due September 30, 2029. The company issued $75 million on September 1, 2026, with another $75 million expected in October 2026. Interest is payable semiannually, and the notes are redeemable at par plus accrued interest and, if applicable, a make-whole premium. Proceeds will be used to repay $150 million of 4.04% notes due 2026 and manage borrowings under its credit facilities to fund investments and general purposes.
: Private placement of 6.83% Series A Senior Notes due 2029 (Master Note Purchase Agreement)
: Refinance 2026 notes and fund investments with added flexibility
